description: This file defines API routes related to exams in a backend web service. It includes endpoints for retrieving exam configurations, starting exam attempts, fetching questions, and submitting answers, utilizing FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and domain-specific flows and models.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's application router used to define route endpoints.

classes.name: AuthUser
classes.description: User authentication information injected via dependency.

classes.name: ExamConfigResponse
classes.description: Response schema for exam configuration data.

classes.name: ExamStartResponse
classes.description: Response schema for starting an exam attempt.

classes.name: ExamSubmitRequest
classes.description: Request schema for submitting exam answers.

classes.name: ExamSubmitResponse
classes.description: Response schema for the result of an exam submission.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: Schema representing a question, used in exam question responses.

classes.name: get_exam_config
classes.description: API endpoint to retrieve configuration details for a module's exam.

classes.name: start_attempt
classes.description: API endpoint to initiate a new exam attempt for a user.

classes.name: get_questions
classes.description: API endpoint to fetch exam questions for an active attempt.

classes.name: submit_attempt
classes.description: API endpoint to submit answers for an exam attempt.

methods.name: ExamConfigResponse get_exam_config(module_id: str, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves the exam configuration, includes question count via database queries.

methods.name: ExamStartResponse start_attempt(module_id: str, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: starts an exam attempt, returning attempt details.

methods.name: list[Question] get_questions(module_id: str, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches questions for an exam based on user's active attempt.

methods.name: ExamSubmitResponse submit_attempt(module_id: str, payload: ExamSubmitRequest, user: AuthUser = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles submission of exam answers, computing results and passing status.
